newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom plans $5.8 bln 1997 capital expenditures.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom plans $5.8 bln 1997 capital expenditures.

text.p: Russian natural gas group Gazprom plans to spend 32.5 trillion roubles ($5.8 billion) in capital expenditures this year, focusing on building a major pipeline system to Europe, the company said on Thursday.
"The company continues to fulfill its long term strategic programme, aimed at the development of new gas fields and construction of the Yamal-Europe pipeline," it said in a statement.
"The planned volume of capital expenditures in 1997 is 32.5 trillion roubles."
Gazprom, the world's largest natural gas company, is building the Yamal pipeline system to export natural gas to Europe and hopes to send the first gas in late 1999.
